title: Mouse character integration and owner regressions
acceptance_criteria: Pickup/drop all mouse medical states through normal requests; preserve UUID, Mind, flags and stale-token denial.
Client pickup/hover use resolved projection and shared eligibility, retaining item priority and occupied-hand routing.
Shared flight retains gravity, drag, collision and authority; one-tick packets are not GPU smoothness proof.
Names retain Components/custom priority; generic hand HUD consumes presented hover names; chunk logs deduplicate.
Five-second player/AI escape retains input sequence and operation during carrier motion/hand selection; relative movement, damage and physical transfer cancel; backpack escape/control/flee persist.
Autonomous mouse travel uses resolved sprint speed; player gait is unchanged.
Playable throws preserve complete flight leases, production codec snapshots and committed identity/control through expiry; valid retained dead bodies share corpse flight.
Inherited Pullable uses normal human pull/stop for alive/critical/dead mice; mice remain handless non-pullers.
Held camera restores native placement; disposal unit shares human-height view across occupants; transit alignment remains separate. GPU placement is unverified.
Held-jump traces capture grounded starts and vanilla packets; remote-client landing presentation remains unverified.
Fresh counted JVM, focused/full native and affected readiness checks pass before packaging; no owner acceptance or deployment is implied.
manual_steps: Provide a concise checklist with each validated build; automated evidence is not owner acceptance.
Drag, pick up, drop and throw alive/critical/dead mice; verify original identity and playable control.
Check readable hand/examine names, restored held camera, above-bin view and successful disposal flush/outlet.
Check five-second escape with moving captor and active-hand changes, backpack escape and immediate AI fleeing. Only the escaping actor sees contained progress in standard SS14.
Watch sustained jumping from another client for visible landings; check autonomous travel and retained throw smoothness. These GPU/input boundaries are not proved by server fixtures.

checks.rationale: One full fresh JVM run; avoid overwriting bound XML with a later focused run.
